name: Magic Link Sign-in
description: A dark passwordless sign-in card that staggers in from blur, then morphs into “Check your inbox” with a folding envelope, Open Gmail/Outlook and a resend timer.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Send the link. Reject with an Error to show its message in the error banner. Also used by Resend.

props.name: expired
props.description: Open in the expired-link state, with the heading and button rewritten.

props.name: defaultEmail
props.description: Prefills the email field (useful with expired).

props.name: sender
props.description: Your From address. The Gmail button searches for it.

props.name: providers
props.description: Extra or overriding domain → webmail mappings (e.g. your company’s Google Workspace domain).

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the primary button in both views. Leave it unset to use the theme ink. Its label flips black or white for contrast.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface palette, envelope included. Both are tuned.
